feature: Split settings.tsx route files (1267 lines in backoffice, 879 lines in minside)
description: The settings.tsx route files in both backoffice and minside have grown into monolithic components handling multiple unrelated settings domains. The backoffice version (1,267 lines) manages 7+ different settings tabs inline with complex form state management across profile, addresses, general settings, booking settings, notifications, integrations, and branding.
